senses.gloss: Yuvamahārāja (IE 8-2; EI 3, 20, 24), modification of Yuvarāja; designation of the heir-apparent or crown-prince; same as Mahāyuvarāja.

Yuvarāja (IE 8-2, CII 3, 4; HD; ASLV), designation of the heir-apparent or crown-prince. See Arthaśāstra, I. 12 (mentioned among the 18 tīrthas); cf. CII, Vol. II, Part i, p. 40.
 Cf. Tamil Tuvarāśan̤ (EI 4), also Duvarāja.
 Cf. Mahāyuvarāja (EI 32), same as Yuvamahārāja (q. v.).
